title: Email/set create uses Newsgroups header with comma separation but RFC 5536 requires space
description: email/set.rs create_one_email() builds the Newsgroups header as newsgroups.join(',') (comma-separated). RFC 5536 §3.1.4 specifies the Newsgroups header value as a comma-space-separated list (CFWS is permitted but commas are the separator). The downstream validate_post_headers and mailparse parsers may or may not accept a bare comma without space. More importantly, the existing NNTP/JMAP roundtrip treats the Newsgroups value as the canonical group list; bare commas without space could cause parse failures on some peers.
